compact-deterministic-cbor.description: Provisional compact codec implementing RFC 8949 core deterministic encoding (section 4.2) for the supported value subset: UTF-8 text strings, integers, booleans, null, definite-length arrays, and string-keyed definite-length maps with keys sorted per RFC 8949 section 4.2.1 (length first, then bytewise). No tags, no floating-point numbers, no indefinite lengths, no byte strings. This is NOT the frozen production canonicalization profile: spec/architecture.md section 7 leaves the exact production canonicalization profile to later conformance work before production wire compatibility is declared.

json-debug.description: Required human/debug encoding (spec/architecture.md section 7). Deterministic canonical JSON form: object keys sorted by UTF-16 code-unit order, minimal JSON escaping, no insignificant whitespace, UTF-8 output, integers in shortest decimal form, absent optional members omitted rather than null. Floating-point values are outside the canonical subset and fail safely. Provisional until the production canonicalization profile is frozen by later conformance work.

compatibility_rules.known_additive: parse and preserve unknown optional content according to negotiated capability
compatibility_rules.unknown_optional: preserve and forward where proxying semantics permit

description: Protocol version line and envelope compatibility semantics for the ADCOS stable protocol envelope (spec/architecture.md section 7). Established by WORK-003. The Protocol Version is an independent version line: it is not the Architecture Version, not a Schema Version, and not an Implementation Version (spec/governance.md section 3). The envelope wire contract carries the protocol major version; minor-version evolution is additive and expressed through preserved unknown optional content, never through silent field rewrites.

capability.advertise.description: Capability advertisement message type named by spec/architecture.md section 7. Payload schema and advertisement/negotiation runtime semantics are owned by WORK-005; at the envelope level the payload is typed-opaque content.
